heading: Liability for acts of officers and agents
lead: The corporation is liable for the acts of its officers and agents acting within the scope of their authority.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2021136 App.:5809.Nov. 18, 1997, Pub. L. 105–85, title XV, § 1509, 111 Stat. 1965. The words “officers and agents” are substituted for “officers, directors, employees, and agents” for consistency in the revised title and to eliminate unnecessary words.
